title: Gathering for the construction of the meeting tent
description: Moses gathers the entire congregation of Israel and first reminds them of the Sabbath command. Then he asks for voluntary offerings for the construction of the tabernacle, and the people—both men and women with willing hearts—bring gold, silver, bronze, wool, linen, skins, acacia wood, precious stones, spices, and oil. The women spin wool and goat hair. Moses announces that the Lord has called Bezalel from the tribe of Judah and Oholiab from the tribe of Dan, filled them with God's Spirit, wisdom, and skill in all kinds of craftsmanship to carry out the work.
